about:
# Happy Camper Broker

Camp buff status and Happy Camper controls on your broker bar.

For **World of Warcraft: Forever** (interface 16001).

- Camp-buff status, missing buffs and expiration information.
- Convenient access to Happy Camper controls.
- A lightweight companion to the original Happy Camper addon.

## Requirements

HappyCamper

A LibDataBroker display such as Bazooka is needed to show broker controls.

## Controls

Use the Happy Camper broker object.

## Installation

Install through CurseForge or extract the ZIP into your Forever Interface/AddOns folder. Keep the packaged folder name `HappyCamper_LDB` unchanged; this also preserves existing saved settings. Enable the listed dependencies.

## Publishing

Push a stable annotated version tag matching the TOC, such as `v1.0.1`, to publish. GitHub Actions validates the source and packages a GitHub release; the connected CurseForge native packager handles the CurseForge Release file through its push webhook. No CurseForge publishing token belongs in this repository or its Actions secrets.

## Feedback

[Report an issue](https://github.com/bhuddleston42/HappyCamperBroker/issues) with the addon version, expected behavior and Lua error if available.

## Testing

Release packaging and Lua syntax are checked automatically. Included regression tests use simulated game APIs. Real gameplay and combinations of third-party addons can expose additional issues; please report them.
